features.name: Current activity
features.note: Layout matches UWP. 'Get Current Activity' is wired and responds in both apps (device-gated error status: UWP shows 'Access denied to activity sensors', WinUI shows 'No activity sensor found' — both valid no-sensor states on this machine). Control coverage 1/1.

features.name: Activity history
features.note: Layout matches UWP. 'Get Activity History' is wired and responds in both apps. Control coverage 1/1.

features.name: Events
features.note: Layout matches UWP. Control coverage 2/2. 'ReadingChanged On' responds in both; 'ReadingChanged Off' is inert in both (invoke fails identically in UWP and WinUI — the button is disabled until a subscription is active), so this is parity, not a regression.

features.name: Background activity
features.note: Behavioral regression: 'Register Task' responds in the UWP golden (updates the Status bar) but is DEAD in WinUI (invoked, but produced no output/status change; newTokens 0, post-click frame did not update). Control coverage is 2/2 and layout matches UWP, but a present-yet-dead control caps this at partial per the scoring rule. 'Unregister Task' is disabled/inert in both (parity).
